Marco Zero Campus in 3 classes.

class_3.Rd

This is to do. This is to do. This is to do. This is to do.

Usage

class_3

Format

`class_3` Is a classification of landcover. The raster has 148 rows and 268 columns:

location

Amapá, Brazil

coord. ref

SIRGAS 2000 / UTM zone 22S (EPSG:31982)

year

2025

Details

A classification of the Marco Zero Campus.

Examples

# plot to see the raster cover classes
# internal raster data needs to be read
plot(terra::rast(class_3))
